note: Literature reviews report skeletal abnormalities in 23/28 (82%) of patients overall, while a recent patient with a novel missense variant lacked skeletal anomalies.

evidence.text: A review of 28 individuals with Jaberi-Elahi syndrome found skeletal problems in 23 of 28 patients (~82%), whereas a proband with a novel homozygous missense variant (p.Leu430Pro) did not exhibit any skeletal abnormalities.

source.title: Jaberi-Elahi syndrome: Exploring a novel GTPBP2 mutation and a literature review
source.quote: Moreover, a significant fraction of patients suffer from intellectual disability (23/28), hypotonia (23/28), skeletal problems (23/28), and visual impairment (18/28). In spite of previous patients, the proband in this study did not exhibit any skeletal abnormalities.

numbers.metric: fraction of patients with skeletal problems
